findings_med.title: JobApplicationNavItem checks 'succeeded' instead of 'current'
findings_med.description: The harvey dot condition checks summaryStatus === 'succeeded' but the status record uses 'current'/'regenerating'/'none'. This means the harvey dot never renders in the nav list. Pre-existing on the ai-frontend-work base branch — not introduced by this feature's diff.
findings_med.classification_reason: Pre-existing. File not modified in this feature's diff. The bug was introduced in commit c35809614 on the base branch.
